title: Automated Marketing Tools For Small Business | Encompass

facts.fact: The Encompass page was published on March 7, 2022.
Encompass states that it uses Mautic as its lead capture and email marketing tool and describes Mautic as free.
facts.quote: We use [Mautic](https://www.mautic.org/) as our lead capture tool and email marketing tool. It is awesome and free.

facts.fact: Encompass defines marketing automation as a strategic solution that integrates the tools needed to drive marketing performance, including email, social media management, website analytics, and ad campaign tracking.
facts.quote: Marketing automation is a strategic solution that integrates the tools you need to drive the performance of your marketing initiatives.

facts.fact: Encompass describes email marketing automation as automatically sending targeted emails to leads and customers.
facts.quote: For example, email marketing automation automatically sends targeted emails to leads and customers.

facts.fact: Encompass states that lead generation tools are marketing automation tools that help generate leads by finding people interested in a business and sending them personalized messages.
facts.quote: Lead generation tools are marketing automation tools that help you generate leads.

facts.fact: Encompass claims that marketing automation lets small businesses execute like big companies without hiring an extra employee, but gives no figures for this claim.
facts.quote: lets small businesses execute like big companies do – without hiring an extra employee.

facts.fact: The page states that Mautic was founded in 2014.
facts.quote: Mautic is an open-source marketing automation platform. Founded in 2014, they’ve grown to over 200,000 installations.

facts.fact: The page states that Mautic has grown to over 200,000 installations, a figure the vendor's own promotional copy presents without an independent source.
facts.quote: Founded in 2014, they’ve grown to over 200,000 installations.

facts.fact: The page states that Mautic is free, though it also offers premium services.
facts.quote: Is that it is free, packed with features and premium services.

facts.fact: The page says that most marketing automation platforms charge a fee, and only a couple of apps can be bought for a single payment rather than a recurring cost.
facts.quote: Most marketing platforms charge a fee, and many quickly become sizable investments. Only a couple of apps will let you purchase the application for a single payment.

facts.fact: Encompass states that with simple campaigns most users launch an automated marketing campaign in under an hour, while complex campaigns can take much longer.
facts.quote: With simple campaigns most users launch in under an hour. Complex campaigns can take much longer
